# Krishna Pinnamaneni

## Identity

Krishna Pinnamaneni is positioned as a local-first AI product builder: PayPal-scale consumer platform experience, Loyumi, DealDesk.fyi, 90+ Apple App Store apps, 25+ books, Microsoft Store apps, Chrome extensions, Android apps, and practical advisory judgment for AI and product companies.

## Public directories

- Web products: [Loyumi](https://loyumi.com/) offers a controlled Sandbox loyalty-migration pilot; [DealDesk.fyi](https://dealdesk.fyi/) provides independent shopping-deal research and price comparisons.
- Apple App Store apps: 90+ apps, including KaiInbox, StatementSnap, BusinessDesk, LocalPDF Desk, ProofNet, LockBuddy, MetaFix, PermitPilot, Pay Packet, Case Binder, and many others.
- Other platforms: Apps and extensions for Microsoft Store, Chrome, and Android.
- Technical books: 25+ books, including AI Code Governance, Context Engineering for Coding Agents, Agent Engineering in Production, AI-Native Engineering, Codex, Claude, Gemini, Prompt Engineering, The Autonomous Company, The Big Tech Interview Operating System, and mobile developer handbooks.
- Browser tools: 15 browser extensions, Chrome apps, browser plugins, prompt-protection tools, lead follow-up tools, permit tools, PDF tools, and browser games.
